# Lancaster Float Company — llms.txt
# https://lancasterfloatco.com

## Business

Lancaster Float Company is a locally owned balloon and event styling business serving Lancaster County, Pennsylvania and surrounding areas. We provide custom balloon arches, garlands, and full event decor for weddings, birthday parties, baby showers, corporate events, graduations, and any celebration that deserves a beautiful installation.

**Phone:** 717-537-0549
**Instagram:** @lancasterfloatco
**Location:** Lancaster, PA
**Service Area:** Lancaster, Lititz, Ephrata, Manheim, Mount Joy, Elizabethtown, Strasburg, Columbia, Millersville, York, Harrisburg, Lebanon
